arithmetic.semantics: B-A wraps to 32 bits before signed absolute value; all sums wrap to 32 bits
arithmetic.limit: Software arithmetic identities only; no RTL or workload simulation

controller_proof.scope: Three concrete masked blocks produce33; public ADD conflict returns30; arbitrary native output readiness; hold stability, public/native exclusion, reset at18 and completion after restart. Bank model implements native ADD/SUB/PASS with two-cycle response. This is not full PrimitiveBank/controller equivalence or arbitrary-data whole-endpoint proof.

limitations: No whole-workload equivalence or CGRA performance claim.
Software arithmetic checks do not exercise RTL.
Initial sv2v formal translation strips assertions and was discarded; final proof reads SystemVerilog directly with async2sync and chformal lowering.
